title: Create an account and activation invitation
steps: Open an approved joiner request and verify identity linkage.
Create the account and approved initial assignment.
Send an expiring activation invitation; inspect activation status.
validation: Never reuse a leavers account for a new person. No shared password or self-chosen role at sign-in.
system: Create user, employee link, grant and audit. User sets credentials through the approved activation flow.
report: Admin metrics track provisioning turnaround and unresolved access requests.
exception: Duplicate identity or absent placement blocks activation rather than creating broad default access.

title: Grant a role with precise organisation scope
steps: Choose the approved role and exact organisation nodes.
Preview menus, record scope, approvals and export permissions.
Commit the effective-dated grant and notify the employee.
validation: Role and scope are separate. Additional teams need explicit grants; permission preview must expose unintended unions.
system: Version grant, invalidate policy caches and revoke obsolete sessions where required.
report: Audit identifies who requested, approved and executed the grant.
exception: Conflicting grants or a reporting cycle block publication. Administrative authority is not a routine sales override.

title: Grant a second team or vertical in the same role
steps: Inspect the approved additional scope and duration.
Preview union and per-team filters with duplicated membership checks.
Activate only the requested team/vertical scope.
validation: No other role menu appears. Cross-vertical TL summaries label each vertical and deduplicate overlapping facts.
system: Add a separate scope grant and refresh allowed filters, notifications and exports.
report: Team reports remain partitioned; combined views use unique fact IDs.
exception: Revoking the added grant removes its data and queued exports immediately while preserving permitted historical reports.

title: Create or restructure the reporting hierarchy
steps: Create an approved unit or draft a parent/reporting change.
Preview descendants, supervisor paths and permission impact.
Publish the dated structure after required approval.
validation: Block cycles, invalid cross-vertical parents and ambiguous primary performance paths. Executive finance reporting is a separate relationship.
system: Version organisation edges and refresh scope indexes without rewriting old attribution snapshots.
report: Historical reports retain event-time paths. New facts use the newly effective hierarchy.
exception: Unresolved orphan teams or missing accountable owners block activation.

title: Activate a transfer or promotion
steps: Review business approvals and the access/workload impact preview.
Confirm the dated role and handoff plan.
Activate; verify the employee now lands in the new role interface.
validation: No automatic carryover of old live access. Historical personal summaries remain inside current-role reports.
system: Close/open assignment intervals, revoke sessions, clear caches and trigger confirmed handoffs.
report: New facts use the new assignment. Prior facts and PDFs retain their historical identity.
exception: Failed activation transaction leaves the prior valid state intact and raises an Admin incident.

title: Disable access and complete offboarding
steps: Review the exit or urgent suspension authority.
Disable sign-in and revoke active sessions and integration grants.
Verify report schedules, approvals and work queues have accountable owners.
validation: Account disable is immediate at the effective time. Preserve evidence and history under the approved retention policy.
system: Revoke tokens, cancel inaccessible jobs, stop new routing and execute approved handoff tasks.
report: Audit disable time, completion and residual-access checks.
exception: If reassignment cannot finish immediately, access still ends and work enters a supervised holding queue.

title: Reset account access safely
steps: Verify the employees identity through the approved recovery process.
Issue a time-limited recovery action and revoke compromised sessions.
Review completion without viewing or setting a shared employee password.
validation: Recovery never changes role scope or bypasses inactive employment. Privileged recovery requires stronger verification.
system: Log recovery initiator, evidence reference, expiry and session revocation.
report: Track failed recovery and repeated lockout incidents separately from sales performance.
exception: Unverified requests remain blocked and route to the security owner.

title: Publish an approved rule version
fields: Stage, SLA, routing or fiscal calendar
steps: Load an approved change and validate the schema.
Preview affected screens, tasks, targets and reports.
Publish on schedule with a rollback plan for future configuration.
validation: Admin executes approved rules; they do not invent accounting policy or approve their own financial benefit.
system: Version configuration, store approval and activate workers with policy-version checks.
report: Events retain the rule version used. Report definitions remain traceable across changes.
exception: Incompatible or untested changes stay in draft. Migration of active opportunities requires separate approval.

title: Investigate an access or data-change incident
steps: Filter immutable audit records within incident authority.
Trace account, request, policy version and before/after changes.
Create an incident action or revoke access when authorised.
validation: Audit access is restricted and itself logged. Logs must not expose passwords, tokens or unnecessary sensitive content.
system: Record investigation and link evidence without altering original audit events.
report: Report access anomalies, resolution time and repeated policy failures.
exception: Exceptional data inspection requires a named, time-limited grant. No silent impersonation of employee dashboards.

title: Recover a failed integration or report job
steps: Inspect permitted job metadata and failure cause.
Retry a safe failed job or route it to the service owner.
Verify success and reconcile duplicate-safe results.
validation: Admin job access does not reveal customer payloads without a separate grant. Recheck user scope before replaying exports.
system: Use bounded retries, dead-letter handling and unique event keys; log operator action.
report: Show failed job age and last successful source watermark.
exception: Expired permission or offboarded job owner blocks execution and requires an authorised replacement.

title: Review expiring access and temporary delegation
steps: Open upcoming expiries and inspect actual business need.
Request renewal approval or allow scheduled expiry.
Verify removal from menus, records, reports and background jobs.
validation: Delegation is role/action/scope/time limited. It cannot exceed the delegators authority or bypass independent approval.
system: Expire or renew the explicit grant and invalidate sessions/caches as required.
report: Report overdue access reviews and temporary-grant duration.
exception: No response means expiry, never indefinite renewal or automatic transfer of authority.
